areas.understanding: EluSlot is a local-first node-based engineering workbench, combining architecture and UI specification authoring, tasks/history, Agent execution, Git, deployment queries and evidence review. Rust/Tauri is formal; older SGenAxis/VGenAxIs names persist in code and documents.

Root/Layer/Module/Node organization, typed node palette, input/output connections, node-specific specification fields, dependencies, BDD/TDD text, selection/parenting, filtering, layout and XML persistence. Layer identity is inferred from member kinds; visual placement is distinct from dependency/execution semantics.
areas.status: SOURCE + UI OBSERVED; not all editing paths exercised

areas.understanding: Ten architectural kinds API/Contract/UI/Command/Query/Application/Domain/Infrastructure/ACL/Custom plus WorkItem, Deployment, CodeFile, Test, Build, AITask and Layer. WorkItem carries workflow/test/lamp/priority/acceptance/cost metadata and a separate event list. Design-node fields are not proof of executed tests, actual token accounting or deployment.
areas.status: SOURCE + UI OBSERVED; advanced history/aggregation design is not full runtime proof

areas.understanding: UI Layer references design document; Edit/Viewer open through Tauri window path or browser embedded fallback. Palette includes window/layout/navigation/input/data/3D/feedback/overlay/interaction/workspace kinds. Canvas supports geometry, grid/rulers, selection, properties, ordering/layout, behavior hints, BDD/TDD hints, preview and Ask draft. Palette availability is not a fully functional runtime implementation of every widget.
areas.status: SOURCE + browser Edit/Behavior UI OBSERVED; native Tauri window NOT RUN

areas.understanding: Current designer DesignDoc persists type/parent/props and behaviorHints/bddHint/tddHint. Property registries include CommandBinding and StateController. Full Event Definitions, Logic Graphs, typed binding validation and execution appear in UI-bhv design; current host preview renders selectable nodes and their hints. This is not evidence of a complete executable UI logic engine.

Ten-crate workspace: core, ports, adapters, exec, listen, guard, evid, spec, work, host; independent Tauri package. Core Property/Dirty/Evaluation/Flow/Edit; Host settings/composition and filesystem integration; DispatchHost assembles Run, work leases, evidence and SPEC projections. Current architecture/UI authored documents also live in JavaScript state and codecs; they are not all Rust Domain objects yet.

Existing product EXEC has CLI and outbound MCP providers with common Run events. Single in-flight Run and project/work-item/fingerprint binding; provider success is separate from evidence/acceptance. Production composition still uses FakeMcpClient and fake workspace probe/store. Incoming Agent MCP and embedded Agent chat/terminal work are new proposals, not existing capability. Ask Agent currently generates a local BDD draft and optionally a gray task, not a model inference call.
areas.status: SOURCE; real Agent/MCP integration NOT RUN

areas.understanding: Rust commands provide Git summary/diff and gated commit/push; deploy commands query capabilities/artifacts/checks, not automatic installation. The newer Git and settings UX screens also include explicit mock modules and fake data, so visible actions cannot all be treated as live Command wiring.

Static port 8770 serves UI without Tauri invoke. Product reads local board snapshot through commands; Python PM board and dispatcher are distinct tooling. Product FLOW/EVID acceptance must not be inferred from Python board done-to-green transitions.
areas.status: BROWSER confirmed no IPC; runtime not live desktop

areas.understanding: PRODUCT-DEVELOPMENT still says implementation not started despite present code, so its status header is stale. Final-2026-10-25 node/UI/deployment documents provide product intent; their proposed features must be checked against handlers/codecs and actual behavior. Prior Agent-integration reports are proposals and must not supersede existing product XML semantics.
areas.status: READ; design is not execution proof
